did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A comment with two product links was left on a help post: one to Napa and one to a medicine that does not exist. The same post was then opened by a guest, by a shop (tier C) and by a wholesaler who has no medicine category.

checks.text: A guest sees a Napa card at the retail price of 300 taka per box
A shop in price tier C sees the same card at its own price, 240 taka per box
A wholesaler whose account has no medicine category sees no Napa card at all, because medicine is not shown to them
The link to a medicine that does not exist shows "This product is no longer available." for everyone
Found and fixed: a pasted link to our own site with a port (as on a test server) was refused without any visible message; the port is now ignored when checking the address

notes: Done by hand in the live browser. New automatic test in HelpBoardTest for the link with a port; the comment refusal now uses its own message place.

shots.caption: Wholesaler without a medicine category: no Napa card, only the gone product note
Guest: Napa card at the retail price (300)
Shop in tier C: the same card at its own price (240)
